column1: # Explanation script revision 4, frozen (2026-11-19) -- the file the boot declaration of the C1 cycle cites

# the regression on the 2026-11-16 inputs (out/compare_r3_r4_2_*.txt), the dry runs (out/dry_*_2.log).
